author: BoldAndBrash
body:
So this was too big to put onto the other post so i decided to just make a new post. (Go ahead and lock if this counts as spam)

My brother got an idea for a new gamemode idea and i made this post dedicated to the kits and sets.
ALL CLASSES HAVE 1 GOLDEN APPLE AND GRENADE

Jumper I is a class for getting up into places where the enemy does not expect you to drop down from. Jumper has access to a stone sword and full chainmail armor. Jumpers special ability is by double jumping you jump 8 blocks.

Heavy I is a great pvp class. You have access to an iron chestplate and chainmail hat , pants , and boots your weapon is a stone sword. As your special ability you have resistance 1.

Medic I is a support class that focuses on keeping your team alive.You have full gold armor and a gold sword. You also have 3 health splash potions.Your special ability is a cobweb the when you right click on an ally he will regenerate health.Every 10 seconds of regenerating a ally will give 2 exp to the medic.

Engineer I is a support class that makes sure your team stays stocked on grenades and arrows on the front lines.You have full leather armor and an iron sword. You can place a chest that resupplys arrows and grenades.Ally players can restock every minute. Every time someone restocks the engi gets 1 exp.

Sniper I this kit is meant to snipe with a bow from far away. You have only a leather chestplate.You are the only class with a bow. You have a bow with power 1 and 30 arrows.Your special ability is speed 1

Mech Suit I this is the premium kit for Titan. You are the best pvp kit with full a diamond chest plate and leggings and iron boots and a iron hat. You also have an iron sword. Your special ability is resistance 2 but you have slowness one and you can only use this class every 5 minutes.
